criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered and dark; 1, 4 and 9 hold one lit subject in a pool but the SDF dog has club paws. Frame 5 a banded clip on a primitive monitor in the grey middle; frame 3 labels and footer on smudge plates and a foreleg out of its box; 6 to 8 three reliefs of squares; 8 a slab with a dead lower third; 7's pockets flat black at feed size.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, the box motif changes state, one dog, no strobe; the declared cut at 6 is a real seam.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and quotes on 2, 4 and 9 match. Charged: slide 5 closes the c4 quote with the stop inside the marks though the source sentence continues; the docket summary's 'That last call rests on appearance' and slide 4's kicker imply the release's description is the review's rule; the announcement filed as key_dates 'effective' with status 'decided'; the cover reads citywide until slide 6 scopes it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and when are clear; no area named, nothing decided or by whom, why loose dogs are a city problem unstated, nothing to do; the 2019 baseline absent.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Concrete cover and slide 2; the turn at 4 not followed; 5 repeats 3, 6 and 7 repeat; the close a borrowed quote.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, every house rule held, a sharp closing question; flat mechanism lines; no regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New topic and animal subject; a lastLight street with a car, a caliche relief and grids of squares echo recent decks.

ranked_defects.defect: The quote's stop sits inside the marks though the source sentence continues.
ranked_defects.fix: Put the stop outside the closing mark.
Fetch the 2019 ACS study PDF through fetch_doc.py and claim its headline count.
Cut it or rebuild it around c11's videos.
Name how a resident reaches ACS from a fetched page.

ranked_defects.defect: Kicker and docket summary imply the release's description is the review's rule.
ranked_defects.fix: Kicker 'How the release describes them'; summary 'The release describes strays as appearing malnourished and skittish'.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Map the frame 1 render target onto the screen; screen-only light.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slab in a void, dead lower third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low raking oblique, rule in the lower third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Labels on smudge plates; foreleg out of the box.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Labels in the dark field; widen the bottom corners.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat black pockets; repeats 6's plan view.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Key at about 12 degrees; oblique camera.
